page.heading: Accrued Expenses
page.caption: Recognized supplier obligations awaiting the actual bill

search.placeholder: Search by name, supplier, or period...

empty.title: No accrued expenses yet
empty.message: Accrue from a contract cycle when the period closes before the supplier bill arrives.
empty.outstanding_message: Outstanding accruals waiting for a supplier bill will appear here.
empty.partial_message: Accruals with at least one settlement but not fully reconciled will appear here.
empty.settled_message: Fully reconciled accruals will appear here.

form.name: Accrual Name
form.name_info: Descriptive label for the accrued obligation.
form.supplier_contract_info: The contract whose cycle is being accrued.
form.supplier_info: Supplier the obligation is owed to. Defaults from the contract.
form.recognition_date_info: Date the obligation is booked into the period.
form.period_start_info: Start of the period the accrual covers.
form.period_end_info: End of the period the accrual covers.
form.cycle_date_info: Cycle bucket (YYYY-MM-DD) used for idempotency against the recurrence engine.
form.accrued_amount_info: Estimated obligation for the period, in the accrual currency.
form.settled_amount_info: Sum of settlements applied so far. Read-only; updated by Settle Accrual.
form.remaining_amount_info: Accrued amount minus settled amount. Read-only.
form.status_info: Lifecycle state. New accruals default to Outstanding and progress as settlements arrive.
form.expense_account_info: GL account to debit when the obligation is recognized.
form.accrual_account_info: GL account to credit while the accrual is outstanding.

confirm.delete_message: Are you sure you want to delete this accrual? Only Outstanding accruals can be deleted.
confirm.settle_message: Apply a settlement against this accrual? You will be prompted for the linked bill and amount.
confirm.reverse_message: Reversing flips this accrual to Reversed and posts a reversing journal. If a linked bill has already been disbursed, you will need a separate disbursement reversal to reconcile cash. Continue?

info.reversed_notice: This accrual has been reversed and no longer affects the books.
info.disbursement_warning: A linked bill is already disbursed. Reversing here requires a separate disbursement reversal to reconcile cash.
